description.value: At 4th level, an engineer can build a support droid. Support droids, like Automatons, are unintelligent constructs that follow the engineer's instructions unfailingly. The support droid uses the engineer's total level for Hit Dice purposes, has half the engineer's total hit points (rounded down), uses the engineer's base attack bonus, and uses the engineer's basic saving throws with its own ability modifiers. It starts as Tiny, flies 30 ft. (perfect), and has two support modes (Repair and Shield) at a 30 foot range, gaining Fine-Tuning (Evasion) at 4th level. It gains further upgrades at 8th (Upgrade 1, telepathic link), 10th (Improved Fine-Tuning), 12th (Upgrade 2, Attack mode), 15th (Stout Servant, DR 5/-), 16th (Upgrade 3, Disrupt mode), and 20th level (Master Upgrade, darkvision, low-light vision, and a force field granting 50 bonus hit points). If destroyed, the engineer must rebuild from scratch at 100 gil per hit dice, requiring 8 hours of uninterrupted work.
